_provenance: Per-team final scores read from the StatsBomb open-data match-summary files at commit d07ebdad. The raw event fixtures under raw/events/ carry no score field; this companion records the goals PER TEAM ID so TF-46 Guard 1 (goal reconciliation) compares each team's SPADL goals to its score (not a direction-blind multiset). The team ids are the StatsBomb team_ids present in the committed event fixtures.
